name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and palmitoylation
rationale: Members cover autoproteolysis, cysteine palmitoylation/N-terminal lipidation and Hh-Np release or ERAD of Hh mutants, i.e. Hedgehog ligand maturation, unlike Wnt lipidation, RAS processing or downstream SMO/GLI signalling in the confusables.

name: PTEN-mediated restraint of PI3K-AKT signaling
rationale: Members concern PTEN expression, stability and localization, ceRNA/lncRNA control of PTEN, AKT targets and negative regulation of PI3K-AKT/IGF1R/ERBB signalling, whereas confusables centre on nuclear PIP/inositol phosphate metabolism.

core: renal and hormonal control of body fluid and blood pressure
name: Vasopressin and angiotensin control of fluid balance and blood pressure
rationale: Members cover vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, renin-angiotensin regulation, urine volume and systemic arterial pressure, distinguishing it from confusables on osmotic/sodium-chloride transport or vascular smooth-muscle tone.

name: Fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation regulation
rationale: Nearly all members concern fibrin clot dissolution and positive/negative control of plasminogen activation and fibrinogen levels, unlike confusables on coagulation cascade, VWF, contact activation or matrix proteolysis.

name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and TAK1-driven stress kinase activation
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2 and ALPK1 sensing of peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide with K63 ubiquitination and TAK1-mediated JNK/p38 activation, distinguishing it from TLR surface sensing and TLR-TAK1-NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testis development
name: Germ cell meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testis development
rationale: Members cover germ cell proliferation, migration and death, meiosis activation and oocyte maturation plus Sertoli/Leydig/seminiferous tubule development, unlike confusables on gonadotropin-driven ovarian follicle biology or sex determination.

name: SLC26 exchanger transport of sulfate, oxalate and iodide
rationale: All members concern SLC26-family anion exchange of sulfate, oxalate, iodide and chloride and its disorders, unlike bicarbonate, cation-chloride cotransporter, CFTR or thyroid iodide-symporter confusables.

qualifier: signaling, myeloid and keratinocyte target genes
name: RUNX1-centred transcription of signaling, myeloid and keratinocyte genes
rationale: All members are RUNX-family (mainly RUNX1) regulation of target genes in WNT, interleukin, BCR and estrogen signalling and myeloid/keratinocyte differentiation, unlike megakaryocyte or granulopoiesis confusables.

name: FLT3 mutant resistance to gilteritinib, quizartinib, midostaurin, sunitinib, pexidartinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to a specific inhibitor set, distinguished from confusables only by the drugs (crenolanib, sorafenib, lestaurtinib etc.) or by KIT/PDGFR targets.

name: Hypoxanthine and guanine purine salvage
rationale: All members describe purine nucleobase/nucleoside salvage to IMP and GMP (HPRT1-type), whereas every confusable concerns purine catabolism and deamination.

name: Cadherin trafficking, cleavage and degradation in cell adhesion
rationale: Members concern CDH1 processing, trafficking and degradation, CDH11 interactions and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins, unlike confusables on junction assembly, desmosomes or epithelial polarity.

name: N-glycan trimming and mannose and amino-sugar catabolism
rationale: Members cover N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1), lysosomal oligosaccharide and glycoside catabolism and mannose/GlcNAc/sialic acid breakdown and phosphorylation, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar and sialic acid biosynthesis.

name: Dorsoventral spinal cord patterning and interneuron specification
rationale: All members concern dorsal/ventral neural tube patterning and spinal interneuron fate, unlike confusables on floor plate/axial mesoderm, midbrain or forebrain/retina development.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis and pyrimidine deoxynucleoside salvage
rationale: Members cover dNMP/dTTP synthesis and pyrimidine salvage, distinguishing them from deoxynucleotide catabolism and de novo ribonucleotide pyrimidine synthesis confusables.

qualifier: termination, NMD and stalled ribosome rescue
name: Translation termination, nonsense-mediated decay and stalled ribosome rescue
rationale: Members cover translation termination, NMD, no-go and non-stop decay and ribosome quality control of nascent chains, unlike confusables on N-end rule degradation, mRNA 3' processing, nuclear exosome decay or initiation.

qualifier: IL-10, IL-12, IL-2 and Treg-effector balance
name: IL-10, IL-12 and IL-2 production shaping Treg-effector balance
rationale: Members regulate IL-10, IL-12 and IL-2 production, Treg differentiation and activated T cell proliferation, unlike confusables on IL-10/IL-27 signalling, broad T cell suppression or inflammatory cytokine inhibition.

qualifier: oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFR mutants and fusions
name: Oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFR mutant signaling with STAT5 activation
rationale: Members cover FLT3 ITD/fusion/CBL-mutant and PDGFRA/B mutant and fusion signalling, TPO and STAT5 activation, unlike EPO/IL-3 cytokine-STAT5 confusables or ALK/FGFR fusion confusables.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion and neurotransmitter receptor clustering in synapse assembly
rationale: Members cover neurexin/neuroligin and other synaptic adhesion, pre/postsynaptic membrane assembly and AMPA/NMDA/GABA receptor clustering, unlike confusables on dendrite and spine actin remodelling and plasticity.

name: Lymphocyte and dendritic cell homing to lymph nodes
rationale: Members concern lymphocyte homing and migration into lymphoid organs, T/B/dendritic cell chemotaxis, S1P receptor and Cdc42 signalling and lymph node development, unlike gut-lymphoid or chemokine-receptor confusables.

qualifier: nuclear exosome plus ribosome-coupled quality control
name: Nuclear exosome and ribosome-coupled RNA surveillance and decay
rationale: Members span nuclear exosome 3' trimming and decay of CUTs, snRNA, rRNA and tRNA together with NMD, no-go, non-stop and ribosome quality control, unlike confusables on tRNA processing, splicing/3'-end processing or 5'-3' decay.

core: centrosome and microtubule organizing center control
name: Centrosome microtubule nucleation, spindle orientation and centriole-cilium control
rationale: Members cover microtubule nucleation and anchoring at the centrosome, centrosome/spindle positioning, centriole duplication and cilium assembly/disassembly, unlike ciliary trafficking/motility or mitotic checkpoint/cytokinesis confusables.

name: G2 phase and G2/M checkpoint cell cycle programme
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, G2/M checkpoint (Chk1/2 inactivation of Cyclin B-CDK1) and cell cycle gene modules, unlike mitotic progression, E2F G1/S or T cell division confusables.

qualifier: targeting, insertion, folding and quality control
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion, folding and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting and insertion, ER folding, retention, ERQC and retrotranslocation, unlike COPI/COPII vesicle traffic or UPR transcriptional stress-response confusables.

name: Lipoxygenase synthesis of HETEs, hepoxilins and lipoxins
rationale: All members describe lipoxygenase-derived arachidonate products (5-, 12-, 15-HETE, hepoxilins, lipoxins), unlike leukotriene catabolism, omega-3 resolvin or P450 epoxygenase confusables.

name: CFTR epithelial anion-fluid secretion and pH-sensing ion channels
rationale: Members cover CFTR trafficking and disease, anion and transepithelial water transport and pancreatic secretion together with acid-pH response, TALK and TRP channels, unlike polarized protein secretion or sour-taste confusables.
